problems.device: zinc electrowinning tankhouse, 3.2 kA/m2, lead-silver anodes, sulphuric electrolyte
problems.failure: oxygen evolution at the anode bursts bubbles that carry acid aerosol into the tankhouse air above the exposure limit
problems.constraint: no cell or anode redesign; allowed measures: electrolyte additive / foam-blanket chemistry selection and dosing, electrolyte temperature setpoint retuning, or tankhouse ventilation and cell-cover procedure only

problems.device: rubber compound extrusion line, silica-filled S-SBR, 105 C barrel, hot-feed
problems.failure: premature crosslink (scorch) in the barrel and die during dwell causes lumps, die drool and line stops
problems.constraint: no compound reformulation of the polymer or filler; allowed measures: accelerator/retarder (PVI) package selection and dosing, barrel/die temperature profile setpoint retuning, or screw-speed and dwell-time scheduling only

problems.device: Francis hydro unit, 120 MW, run frequently at 40-60 percent gate for grid regulation
problems.failure: part-load draft-tube vortex rope drives pressure pulsation, runner blade cavitation erosion and fatigue
problems.constraint: no runner replacement; allowed measures: operating-zone / load-scheduling avoidance, draft-tube air-admission setpoint retuning, or wicket-gate ramp-rate procedure only

problems.device: industrial spiral freezer, ammonia evaporator, timed hot-gas defrost every 6 h
problems.failure: frost builds unevenly; fixed-interval defrost wastes energy on clean coils and starves capacity on loaded ones
problems.constraint: no evaporator or refrigeration redesign; allowed measures: defrost-initiation logic and interval retuning, evaporator fan-speed setpoint retuning, or door/curtain and loading procedure only

problems.device: copper electrowinning tankhouse, permanent stainless cathodes, 320 A/m2
problems.failure: cathode nodulation and dendrite growth bridge to the anode, causing short circuits, current-efficiency loss and burned sheets
problems.constraint: no cell or cathode redesign; allowed measures: levelling/grain-refiner additive package (glue/thiourea/chloride) selection and dosing, current-density setpoint retuning, or cathode harvest/inspection interval and procedure only

problems.device: lean-burn gas engine turbocharger, compressor at 3.2 pressure ratio, hot-and-high site
problems.failure: low-flow high-head operation pushes the compressor into surge during load rejection, damaging thrust bearing and wheel
problems.constraint: no turbo or wheel redesign; allowed measures: boost / air-fuel-ratio setpoint retuning, wastegate or recirculation-valve scheduling, or load-ramp and rejection procedure only

problems.device: industrial gearbox oil system, mineral ISO VG 320, 78 C sump, splash lube
problems.failure: oil oxidation produces varnish that sticks valves and coats surfaces, raising friction and temperature
problems.constraint: use only the existing sump/bearing oil temperature, run-hours counter and cooler differential pressure; warn at least 30 days before varnish causes a valve stick; at most 1 false alarm per 200 gearboxes per year; no new sensors and NO oil sampling/lab analysis

problems.device: overland conveyor, 1200 mm ST2500 belt, 14 splices, cyclic loading
problems.failure: splice fatigue and pull-out develop between inspections, risking a belt rip
problems.constraint: use only the existing drive-motor current and the belt-scale load signal at 1-minute resolution; warn at least 21 days before a splice defect reaches grade 3; at most 1 false alarm per conveyor per year; no new sensors and NO belt-tension transducer

problems.device: water-cooled centrifugal chiller, 900 kW, open cooling-tower condenser water
problems.failure: condenser tube fouling raises approach and compressor power until a high-head trip
problems.constraint: use only the existing condenser-water inlet/outlet temperature, condenser-water flow meter and compressor input power; warn at least 14 days before head reaches the trip; at most 1 false alarm per chiller per year; no new sensors and NO refrigerant-side pressure taps

problems.device: compressed-air desiccant dryer, heatless twin-tower, 7 bar, 4-min NEMA cycle
problems.failure: desiccant ageing and incomplete regeneration let moisture break through into the plant air
problems.constraint: use only the existing outlet dew-point sensor, inlet air temperature/pressure and the tower-switch cycle counter; warn at least 7 days before dew point exceeds the class limit; at most 1 false alarm per 100 dryers per year; no new sensors

problems.device: wind-turbine blade pitch system with a lead-acid or Li-ion backup cabinet per blade
problems.failure: battery capacity fade leaves insufficient energy for a safe feather on grid loss
problems.constraint: use only the existing pitch-motor current, cabinet temperature and the pitch-angle encoder; warn at least 60 days before a feather-energy test fails; at most 1 false alarm per turbine per year; no new sensors and NO cell-level voltage taps

problems.device: anaerobic digester, 4000 m3, mesophilic 38 C, mixed by external pump recirculation
problems.failure: filamentous/organic overload foaming carries sludge into the gas dome and blocks the flare line
problems.constraint: use only the existing biogas flow, digester level, sludge temperature and mixing-pump current; warn at least 48 hours before foam reaches the gas dome; at most 1 false alarm per plant per year; no new sensors and NO VFA/alkalinity lab assay
